title: Explore PDLC retrieval: context, missing links and history
story: Load the original retrieval test graph. Inspect file context, service dependencies, trust filtering, missing tests, scoped completeness and superseded design history. Expected answers come from the existing tests. This tests retrieval over saved records, not event ingestion or extraction.
